import inspect

import solution
from solution import minimum


def test_issue_example_first_smaller():
    """Example assert minimum(1,2) == 1."""
    assert minimum(1, 2) == 1  # min(1,2)=1


def test_issue_reversed_second_smaller():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(9, 4) == 4  # min(9,4)=4


def test_issue_equal_values():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(6, 6) == 6  # min(6,6)=6


def test_issue_both_negative():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(-3, -8) == -8  # min(-3,-8)=-8


def test_issue_mixed_sign():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(-2, 5) == -2  # min(-2,5)=-2


def test_issue_zero_smaller_than_positive():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(0, 3) == 0  # min(0,3)=0


def test_issue_negative_smaller_than_zero():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(0, -3) == -3  # min(0,-3)=-3


def test_issue_floats():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(1.25, 1.75) == 1.25  # min(1.25,1.75)=1.25


def test_issue_large_numbers():
    """Find the minimum of two numbers."""
    assert minimum(1000000, 999999) == 999999  # min(1000000,999999)=999999


def test_contract_function_exists():
    """Public interface defines minimum(a, b) in solution."""
    assert hasattr(solution, "minimum") is True  # hasattr=True


def test_contract_function_callable():
    """Public interface defines minimum(a, b) in solution."""
    assert callable(minimum) is True  # callable=True


def test_contract_takes_two_parameters():
    """Public interface defines minimum(a, b) with two parameters."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(minimum).parameters) == 2  # 1+1=2
